snippet.title: The Museum of Mr. Pence (PC) - Full Playthrough
snippet.description:
soggy cake

Joking aside, here are some notes:
- I was sick of having to redo the section at 3:39 in Mr. Pence's Christmas Blast, because the mushrooms had glitchy collision that could cause Mr. Pence to get permanently stuck in them. So after a few attempts, I gave up and touched the giant corrupted Mario in New Mr. Pence, which sends you to the Grounder battle in Christmas Blast for some reason.
- I also had to convert the Christmas Blast intro to MP4 and insert it in post, since OBS Studio just showed a blank screen when it tried to record the intro.
- New Mr. Pence has unique death sounds for every location in the game, but I forgot to show off a few of them.
- I got hit by the Goomba in the section leading up to Mr. Pence's Fantastic Museum of Anything Goes, which resets the game for some bizarre reason. I  cut out the part where I used the password to get back to that section.

Timestamps:
1:14 - Mr. Pence's Christmas Blast
9:39 - New Mr. Pence (Germino's story begins at 18:35)
24:02 - Mr. Pence's Fantastic Museum of Anything Goes (timestamp skips to the part where I show off how to get there, actual game begins at 26:05)
28:08 - Scrapped New Mr. Pence level
28:35 - Art Gallery & Credits
